# Country

## Summary
The card form of a country — for realms that want countries as linkable,
shared instances (one card per country, referenced everywhere) rather than
inline values. The same module's `CountryField` covers the inline case.

## Example
```ts
import { Country } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/country';

@field homeCountry = linksTo(Country);
```
Choose the field for per-card values, the card for a shared country list.
